description: Address review findings: fix audit log hash chain in Prisma store, wire usage tracking to ingestion, fix circuit breaker shared state, fix plan naming mismatch, fix usage tracking race condition, remove misleading rate-limit headers, and add documentation for intentional threshold behavior.
steps: Fix PrismaAuditLogStore to persist previousHash and entryHash in the payload JSON before storing, and reconstruct them properly on read
Wire trackTurnUsage into the ingestion route after conversation upsert
Fix the shared mutable circuit breaker by creating per-client circuit breaker instances
Fix the plan naming mismatch by mapping GROWTH to PROFESSIONAL consistently with a shared constant
Fix the usage tracking race condition by using Prisma atomic increment
Remove misleading hardcoded rate-limit headers from ingestion endpoint
Document the intentional threshold floor behavior in code comments
Add test for webhook plan-tier mapping
Verify all existing tests still pass
acceptance_criteria: PrismaAuditLogStore correctly persists and retrieves previousHash and entryHash
Ingestion route calls trackTurnUsage with correct parameters
Circuit breaker state is scoped per-client, not shared globally
Plan tier naming is consistent between billing module and webhook handler
Usage increments use Prisma atomic { increment: 1 } operations
No misleading rate-limit headers in ingestion response
New test validates webhook plan-tier mapping
All existing tests pass (npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build)
findings: All 9 review issues addressed. Issues 1-5 and 7-9 fixed with code changes. Issue 6 (threshold floor) documented as intentional design. Tests grew from 273 to 281 (8 new tests for plan-tier mapping and usage tracking integration). All lint, typecheck, tests, and build pass. The worker exit warning in test output is pre-existing (from latency test).
